dialogues.text: Ah, my savior! Thank you for your help in... defeating these hilichurls.
I was just standing on the cliff admiring the scenery, and one of them knocked me right out. By the time I woke up, I was trapped in here.
It's locked. The key... Ah, right, the key is in that chest over there. Could I trouble you to do me a teensy weensy favor?
I'd be eternally, utterly grateful if you would...
*sob* Freedom! Freedom from this prison at last!
This hot air balloon keeps on swaying this way and that. Heh, who knows, perhaps a gust of wind shall come and blow the whole thing down...
Even Granny Itztli would not be able to save us then, I fear.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you, anyway, and how did you wind up here?

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, I haven't introduced myself. Call me Conulaf, a trainee priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind...

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: As the title suggests, I'm currently in training to be a priest. I've stayed within our tribe all my life, so the elders told me, "why don't you go out and see the world?"

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: And so they kicked me out of the tribe under the guise of training—

dialogues.speaker: Conulaf
dialogues.text: Still, I wouldn't call getting caught by hilichurls the good kind of "seeing the world," would you, my savior?

choices.text: Adventuring on your own's dangerous stuff...

response.speaker: Conulaf
response.text: Indeed, indeed! Were it not for you, I don't know how long I'd have remained trapped in there...

response.speaker: Conulaf
response.text: In any case, thank you so much for saving me, my dear savior... Now, after all this wind I've been subjected to, I should head down before giving my continued training more consideration...

response.speaker: Conulaf
response.text: I don't have much on me, but in my family, we repay kindness when it is shown to us, so let me give you these!

choices.text: Well, so long as you're strong enough...

response.speaker: Conulaf
response.text: Heh... I fear you're not fooling me with that. There just aren't many adventurers as strong as you are in this world...

Agh, the key! The Qucusaurus snatched it right up! Darnit, that's one meanie of a Saurian! We have to catch it!
